notes: Canonical runtime directories are mystrix; pinwheel remains only as a legacy alias and in historical source paths.
Current overlapping resources take precedence over old source content.

target_hash_normalization: For .json, .mcmeta, .glsl, .fsh, .vsh, .txt and .obj: CRLF is normalized to LF; binaries remain exact. Source hashes always describe the original ZIP bytes.
